description.value: The Health Food Centre is a family-owned and operated health store that has served Dawson Creek for 49 years, making it a long-standing institution in this northern BC community. The store stocks a broad range of wellness products including supplements, bulk herbs, GF and vegan food options, aromatherapy, natural beauty care, and an in-store refillery station for eco-friendly household products. For touring cyclists passing through Dawson Creek, it offers a useful stop for specialty dietary staples and natural health supplies.
